summary.text: Chris Sneed is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 14 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Chris Sneed assumed office on November 21, 2018.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Commerce & Economic Development Oversight Committee.
In the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions he chaired the Insurance Committee.
